title: METHOD OF TREATING HUMAN JOINTS ARTHROSIS
abstract: FIELD: medicine.SUBSTANCE: invention refers to medicine and aims at treating joint arthrosis. Following composition is added to synovial bag 1/15–1/14 of the cavity volume, wt%: snake and bee poisons, ginseng from 1 to 2 % each; mummy from 6 to 7 % in blood plasma – balance. Areas of lymph nodes (inguinal, axillary and under the ears) are treated daily by way of gentle massage with pads of phalanxes of fingers, moistened with alcohol composition, obtained by not less than one month liqueur per 1 liter of alcohol 1 kg of dry components with particle size of 1 to 2 mm, including tops of beet and carrots; celandine, aconite, cicuta, propolis, rosehip from 11 to 13 % each and pod-pepper – the rest; as well as orally for 10–15 minutes before each meal a powdery composition is taken, wt%: girasol, caprinus fungus, carrots and beet tops, courgettes, rosehips, ashberry, aspen and alder bark, chaga from 8 to 9 % each and birch buds – balance for 6 months, then monthly interruption of reception, and if necessary, the process is repeated.EFFECT: method widens the range of therapeutic agents.1 cl, 3 ex
